quote: Fluor Corporation (NYSE: FLR) announced today that it has divested its equity stake in ICA-Fluor Daniel to its existing JV Partner, ICA for $175 million. “Since the joint venture was formed in 1993, Fluor and ICA have successfully completed numerous projects in support of Mexico’s oil and gas, power, mining and manufacturing markets,” said Jim Breuer, Fluor’s Chief Executive Officer.
